name: Alaior (Spain)
description: Nine horizontal stripes alternating yellow and light blue, with a yellow saltire over all.
history: The flag of Alaior, also called the flag of Barçola, was approved by agreement of the Government of the Balearic Islands of 8 October 1987 and defined as a square flag of eight horizontal stripes of equal width alternating in colour. It reproduces a flag in the possession of the town council since 1944, which is said to have been raised in 1644 by Miquel Barçola i Cardona in the events known as those of s'Olla de ses Coves, defending the town against Barbary pirates; these events have no contemporary historical support, but the resulting flag is in wide popular use in the municipality.
